name: Salesperson Own Customers
description: Salesperson Own Customers restricts access to customer records in Odoo based on the assigned salesperson. Each salesperson can only view and manage the customers they are responsible for, while managers or specific users can be granted broader access. This ensures better data privacy, improves focus, and enforces sales territory or team boundaries.
